Method of Attack: Requesting access to risky permissions allowing installation of malware
Accessing contact lists, call logs, executing code, fetching malware payloads, clicking on ads
Exploiting ad technology for remote code execution to execute commands on device
Attack Vector: Malicious apps distributed via Samsung Galaxy Store
Indicators of Compromise: Multiple anti-virus engines on VirusTotal detect samples as riskware, trojan, ad clicker, or generic malware
